caption: The drawing depicts a blue, bulbous-shaped bottle with a narrow neck and a round base. The surface of the bottle features a textured, almost quilted pattern composed of elongated oval-like segments running vertically and horizontally, creating a grid-like appearance. The bottle's color varies in shades of blue, with darker blue used to illustrate the shadows and the depth of the pattern, and lighter blue for the highlighted areas. The bottle is centrally positioned on a beige or light tan background that is uniformly colored. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, rectangular inset showing a simplified sketch of the same bottle, viewed from a more upright angle, also rendered in blue. Below and to the left of the bottle, there is a small, horizontal scale line. The name "N. Amantea" is written in small letters in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Flask
